request.requirement: Extract venue listings from table and card HTML. Return every venue with explicit source evidence, capacity, price in integer minor units and ISO currency, available window, availability, and step-free access. Never infer missing prices or facts. Return unsupported with missing_required_data for incomplete listings, or unsupported_format for unknown page formats. Generalize from HTML structure rather than copying sample venue values. Use the fixed TypeScript contract.
